summary: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its consolidated financial results for the fiscal first quarter ended June 30, 2026, and revised its full-year forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The filing includes financial statements, earnings per share, dividends, and explanatory notes. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic actions. The report is routine and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
